tests.name: Baseline reproduction: held external CSS prevents the Figma first paint
Figma splash paints while all 38 external styles are still pending
Ready clinical runtime cannot dismiss startup while styles are incomplete
The exact first-paint assets fit a 360 pixel viewport without overflow
Only after all styles load does the app open its native current-case home
Failed stylesheet is fail-closed with Retry; seeded clinical records are preserved
Stylesheet timeout never exposes unfinished clinical controls
Retry after a stylesheet failure restores normal startup
Installed manifest keeps the exact previous app identity and uses the dark splash color
An online manifest refresh replaces an old cached white splash
Offline manifest requests use the last successfully updated dark copy
HTTP failure cannot replace the cached manifest with an error response
Versioned Android icon URLs are available offline without changing logo bytes
No uncaught runtime errors in first-paint, failure, retry or manifest flows

limits: Chromium mobile emulation; native Android launcher/WebAPK splash not exercised.
A new service worker must first activate through the existing checkpointed update flow.
Chrome controls installed manifest update timing; this code cannot instantly redraw an existing native splash.
